messages:
sylvia: Heads-up — a tier-1 customer requested operator-level outbound controls for Private installs: per-tenant allowlists for external FQDNs/CIDRs and a managed SNAT pool.
laura: Compliance ask. Do they want enforcement in the agent or during installer provisioning?
tim_r: Agent enforcement. They want policies bundled with tenant manifests so upgrades keep rules intact.
derek: If agent enforces, we need a clear admin model: tenant-admin vs platform-admin change rights. Also migration guarantees.
sylvia: Customer example: 'Team A should only reach analytics.example.com and S3.' That implies both destination allowlist and controlled egress IPs.
jen: This affects upgrade/migration: if we change egress implementation (iptables -> eBPF -> cloud NAT), we need a non-breaking migration path.
laura: Proposed approach: 1) declarative EgressPolicy CRD; 2) agent enforcer with enforcementVersion in CR; 3) migration shim for older installs.
tim_r: Example CRD snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: infra.redwood/v1
kind: EgressPolicy
metadata:
  tenant: acme
spec:
  allowedDestinations:
    - dns: analytics.example.com
    - cidr: 10.0.0.0/24
  egressMode: SNAT
  snatPool: tenant-acme-pool
  enforcementVersion: v1
```
derek: enforcementVersion allows controlled rollouts — v2 could be eBPF filters. Agent must support compatibility-mode translation.
jen: UX needs: console view of effective policy, dry-run, audit trail with signer identity (KMS-backed) for operator overrides.
sylvia: Rollback rule: default to "compat translate" rather than deny-by-default. No sudden traffic loss.
laura: SNAT pool migration must preserve IPs for long-lived sessions; add migration window with ephemeral mappings.
tim_r: Performance note: eBPF is cheaper but kernel dependencies matter. Support iptables fallback path for older kernels.
derek: Acceptance criteria for launch: CRD v1 doc + API, agent enforcer (iptables + optional eBPF), migration shim tests, console view, RBAC + audit logs.
jen: Customer acceptance: tenant-admin can propose allowlist and get enforcement within SLA window. Add KMS signing for policy changes in Private installs.
sylvia: Action items: laura+tim draft CRD & migration sketch by EOD Thu; derek+ops prototype iptables shim; jen mock console wireframe. I'll coordinate with account team for exact SLA wording.
